### Brief Solutions

- **[id 130]**: $60 - (60 / 3) = 40$ elves remaining after the first wave; $40 - 10 = 30$ elves left.
- **[id 131]**: June expenditure was $500 - 60 = 440$. Total expenditure for both months was $500 + 440 = 940$.
- **[id 132]**: Total rides taken = $(2 + 4) \text{ coaster} + (2 + 2) \text{ luge} = 10$ rides. Total tickets = $10 \times 6 = 60$.
- **[id 133]**: Tuesday miles = $4 \times 6 = 24$. Wednesday miles = $41 - (4 + 24) = 13$.
- **[id 134]**: Monthly cost = $4 \times 15 = 60$. Yearly cost = $60 \times 12 = 720$.
- **[id 135]**: Brian has $20 - 5 = 15$ games. Bobby has $3 \times 15 - 5 = 40$ games.
- **[id 136]**: Scottish unicorns = $27 / 3 = 9$. Female Scottish unicorns = $(2/3) \times 9 = 6$.
- **[id 137]**: Food subtotal = $(2 \times 7.50) + (2 \times 1.50) + (2 \times 1.00) = 15 + 3 + 2 = 20$. With a 20% fee ($4.00) and $5 tip: $20 + 4 + 5 = 29$.
- **[id 138]**: Test 1 completed = $5 \times 8 = 40$ ($35$ incomplete). Test 2 completed = $5 \times 6 = 30$ ($70$ incomplete). Total incomplete = $35 + 70 = 105$.
- **[id 139]**: Number of pink gumballs = $(4 \times 12) + 22 = 48 + 22 = 70$.
